title: Smart Data Models - Allotrope Foundation Ontologies - PlannedProcess
description: A processual entity that realizes a plan which is the concretization of a plan specification. [IAO] (AFO REC/2026/09 class 'planned process', http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/OBI_0000011. The entity type is the PascalCase form of the AFO skos:prefLabel; attribute names are the camelCase form of the prefLabels of the AFO relations and facet classes they stand for.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'PlannedProcess'

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. The name of this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. A description of this item.

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

afoClass.description: Property. Not an AFO term (Smart Data Models addition): the AFO classes this entity is an instance of, given by their skos:prefLabel, verbatim. Stands for rdf:type; covers the 89 classes of the AFO REC/2026/09 'planned process' branch (the root class and all its subclasses, including classes defined by owl:equivalentClass).

measurementIdentifier.description: Property. Model:'http://purl.allotrope.org/ontologies/result#AFR_0001121'. AFO class 'measurement identifier': Measurement id is measurement metadata that identifies the measuring run. [Allotrope] Flattened: the AFO facet individual is replaced by its literal value, as in the Allotrope Simple Model (ASM) JSON.

startTime.description: Property. Model:'http://purl.allotrope.org/ontologies/result#AFR_0002422'. AFO class 'start time': A start time is a time that denotes the start of some process. [Allotrope] Flattened: the AFO facet individual is replaced by its literal value, as in the Allotrope Simple Model (ASM) JSON.

endTime.description: Property. Model:'http://purl.allotrope.org/ontologies/result#AFR_0002423'. AFO class 'end time': An end time is a time that denotes the end of some process. [Allotrope] Flattened: the AFO facet individual is replaced by its literal value, as in the Allotrope Simple Model (ASM) JSON.

analyst.description: Property. Model:'http://purl.allotrope.org/ontologies/result#AFR_0001116'. AFO class 'analyst': Analyst is measurement metadata about the name or identifier of a person that has the role of an analyst in the measurement. [Allotrope] Flattened: the AFO facet individual is replaced by its literal value, as in the Allotrope Simple Model (ASM) JSON. Use a pseudonymous identifier, not a personal name.

hasMaterialInput.description: Relationship. Model:'http://purl.allotrope.org/ontologies/property#AFX_0000696'. AFO 'has material input': Refers to the material entity that is an input of a process. [Allotrope] Points to PortionOfMaterial entities that enter the process (samples, standards, reagents).

hasMaterialOutput.description: Relationship. Model:'http://purl.allotrope.org/ontologies/property#AFX_0000546'. AFO 'has material output': The material that is output of the process. [Allotrope] Points to PortionOfMaterial entities that come out of the process.

hasParticipant.description: Relationship. Model:'http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_0000057'. AFO 'has participant': A relation between a process and a continuant, in which the continuant is somehow involved in the process [RO] Points to Device entities that take part in the process (instruments, components).

hasDataOutput.description: Relationship. Model:'http://purl.allotrope.org/ontologies/property#AFX_0000544'. AFO 'has data output': Relates a process with an information object that participates in the process and exists the end of the process. [Allotrope] Points to AssayResult entities produced by the process.

hasPrescription.description: Relationship. Model:'http://purl.allotrope.org/ontologies/property#AFX_0002880'. AFO 'has prescription': Has prescription relates an entity to an information content entity that is its prescription. [Allotrope] Points to the AnalyticalMethod entity that prescribes the process.

quantity.description: Property. Model:'http://purl.allotrope.org/ontologies/result#AFR_0001101'. The AFO quantification facet class this value is an instance of, given by its skos:prefLabel, verbatim (e.g. 'mass', 'mass concentration', 'flow rate', 'sample weight'). 179 classes of the AFO REC/2026/09 'quantification facet' branch.

numericValue.description: Property. Model:'http://qudt.org/schema/qudt#numericValue'. QUDT 'has numeric value': the number of the quantity value, in the given unit.

unit.description: Property. Model:'http://qudt.org/schema/qudt#unit'. QUDT 'has unit': IRI of the unit of measure, from the QUDT 1.1 unit vocabulary (http://qudt.org/vocab/unit#...) or the Allotrope QUDT extension (http://purl.allotrope.org/ontology/qudt-ext/unit#...), both distributed with AFO (qudt-ext REC/2026/09, 867 units), e.g. http://qudt.org/vocab/unit#DegreeCelsius.

standardUncertainty.description: Property. Model:'http://qudt.org/schema/qudt#standardUncertainty'. The standard uncertainty of a quantity is the estimated standard deviation of the mean taken from a series of measurements. [QUDT] Same unit as numericValue.

processQuantifiedBy.description: Property. Model:'http://purl.allotrope.org/ontologies/property#AFX_0002686'. AFO 'process quantified by': Relation of some process that is quantified by some quantity value which expresses its duration relative to other process or a temporal aggregation function on the quantification of a quality of some participant over this duration. [Allotrope] Flattened: in AFO the bearer is quantified by a quantity value (qudt:QuantityValue, typed with an AFO quantification facet class) that has a numeric value and a unit; here each item gives that class (quantity), numericValue, unit and optionally standardUncertainty. Typical uses: process parameters and settings such as flow rate, temperature, injected volume or detection wavelength.
